{{Quote|The Core has no need of a military force! We know how to live in peace with one another.|The Kuati senator|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
A [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] '''senator''' served as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] for their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], in [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]]. During a session of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] which involved a discussion on the subject of raising a military, another [[Unidentified individual (Senate Rotunda)|individual]] stated that the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] should pay taxes for raising a military force instead of the outlying [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. The Kuati senator replied that the Core Worlds did not need a military force as the Core Worlds could peacefully coexist.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The senator appeared in [[James Luceno]]'s [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
